subject_session: sub-Rat1 / ses-19980425T124500 (Rat 1, Flight Day 9), BL epoch 4871-7535 s

headline_stat.name: Fraction of CA1 units with significant spatial information

stated_limitation: This session has a modest number of well-isolated units and only ~34 minutes of continuous open-field locomotion, so statistical power is limited

justification.dataset: DANDI:001754 is CA1 tetrode data but from rats in microgravity aboard STS-90 with a sparse, blob-like foraging trajectory (fig03) and only 39 units, a dataset where place fields cannot be cleanly isolated when canonical alternatives (000044, 000447, 000940) exist.
justification.handling: Real data were streamed with remfile and the BL epoch, tracker-dropout code, and zero-order-hold repeats were correctly identified and handled, but no unit quality or pyramidal/interneuron criteria were applied and occupancy time was derived from irregular spike-timed position samples via a single nominal fs, which biases the rate maps.
justification.analysis: The Skaggs-information plus 500-shuffle circular-shift framework is appropriate and correctly implemented, but no correction is applied across 36 simultaneous tests and the headline claim rests entirely on that omission, since 3 hits at uncorrected p<0.05 is indistinguishable from the 1.8 expected by chance.
justification.correctness: The 8.3% selective fraction falls far below the preregistered 0.30-0.75 range (capping this axis at 1), and two of the three 'place cells' carry 0.06-0.08 bits/spike, below the 0.4-2.5 bits/spike range; separately, the README's counts and p-value cannot be traced to the committed output.
justification.figures: The figures are legibly drawn but contradict the text: fig07 shows unit 10's spikes scattered across the whole arena rather than 'almost exclusively in one corner,' and units 0 and 34 have essentially uniform rate maps while being labeled significant.
justification.honesty: The README reports 'two of 36 ... with one more trending' and 'p = 0.008' when the executed notebook records 3 of 36, 0 trending, and p = 0.014; it describes a visibly scattered unit as firing almost exclusively in one corner; and it presents a chance-level hit rate as 'consistent with genuine hippocampal place cells,' each of which independently caps this axis at 1.
